listNote: Official names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation Network, taken 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 27 visible, 28 hidden. All single-player; no online trophies at launch.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: work the roadmap in order — story, strangers and activities, collectibles, robberies and money, then the 100% checklist — and save the gold 'A Long Road' for last. The platinum is reported to take around 200 hours.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long grind behind the platinum: the 100% checklist is built from the same tasks the other trophies name — story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and robberies — so treat this as the cleanup pass, not a separate hunt. Rockstar has published no official checklist at launch, so confirm each task against the cited lists as they are updated.

sources.name: Exophase trophy list via PlanetGTA6 (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's jump and trick challenges; work them in free roam between missions and watch the in-game count. No confirmed stunt list exists at launch — track your count in-game and treat any third-party stunt map as unconfirmed until it is verified.

sources.name: Exophase trophy list via PlanetGTA6 (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one round of every activity the game offers — races, fishing, arcade, drone races, shooting range, bowling and the rest — and the trophy unlocks when the last new type is tried. It is a sampler, not a mastery trophy.

sources.name: Exophase trophy list via PlanetGTA6 (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work them range by range; gold medals are the only requirement, so replay a challenge until the gold threshold is met rather than rushing through all 42 first.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Do this one early and as you go: it is the only trophy reported as possibly missable, because one spot — Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 — is reported to disappear after that chapter, and the game reportedly has no mission replay. Meditate at every spot you find, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; fifty completions across all types. The in-game challenge tracker shows your count, so let this one fill up naturally while you work the other trophies.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Chapters 1–4, the named story missions and the final mission. The story alone is reported to take around 60 hours (VGC / Push Square, via PlanetGTA6). Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — the game reportedly has no mission replay — and meditate at every spot you find in Chapter 1 for 'Positive Mental Attitude'.

roadmap.title: Strangers and activities
roadmap.text: Eight stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and more) plus the activity trophies: 250 stunts, 42 gold-medal shooting range challenges, 20 different races, drone races, fishing, arcade, bowling and 50 challenges. Do the stranger strands as they appear on the map.

roadmap.title: Collectibles
roadmap.text: Meditation spots, 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, and exploring all of Leonida. Sweep the map region by region and fold the WAiNK and vehicle hunts into the same trips.

roadmap.title: Robberies and money
roadmap.text: Shops, jewelry store, 5 bank vaults, armored truck, one illegal operation per gang, then launder $250,000 in marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all garages and register 10 vehicles. Keep cheats off the whole way: turning one on is reported to disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: World secrets, 100%, platinum
roadmap.text: The hidden world trophies and combat feats, then 100% completion ('A Long Road'), and the platinum ('Vice Got a Price!') unlocks with the 54th trophy. The whole run is reported at around 200 hours.
